entries.en: Heavens, I should never have gone[n]out today.
...Ow, ouch! You're quite brutish for a[n]phantom thief, are you not?
My word, this has been quite a day...
I can't quite fathom why any of this[n]is happening.
Care to explain yourself? I certainly hope[n]you have a good reason for this boorish[n]treatment.
That would take a while.
There's no need to explain.
Just shut up...
Oh, that doesn't matter. What's more[n]important is that you explain your[n]behavior to my satisfaction.
I doubt your circumstances are that[n]complicated, but...
In that case, would you distill it to just the[n]main points, then?
Do you honestly expect me to sit here like[n]this while you list all your feeble excuses?
Oh? In that case, I demand you explain to[n]me why there is no need for you to explain.
Are you aware that doesn't answer my[n]question?
I'm inclined to disagree. I may be a hostage,[n]but you still require my cooperation, yes?
Ahh, you're such a troublesome human.
Well, if your explanation is to my satisfaction[n]and I find it reasonable... Perhaps I will.
Apologies, but I simply can't concede[n]to your demands without any sort of[n]explanation.
Oh, you are a brutish child. Must you really[n]be so overbearing?
I don't see how that would benefit anyone[n]other than you. No. No, I shall not shut up[n]and die.
Ah, so you never had any sort of reason at[n]all...
Really, I don't see why you should be angry[n]at me. I'm the victim here, am I not?
...Such a vulgar child.
Ah, I wish to return home...
Excuse me, I believe this can be considered[n]sexual harassment.
I insist you surrender yourself to the[n]authorities.
This is a misunderstanding.
I apologize.
You've got the wrong idea.
Ah, but most men say that after the fact.[n]Am I not right?
A misunderstanding? Do remember that I[n]was the one who was harassed. You touched[n]me amidst the confusion, didn't you?
Are you suggesting that you could not resist?[n]Perhaps crying myself to sleep is now my[n]only recourse.
Nonetheless... I am feeling quite agitated.
Very well. I suppose that I should[n]acknowledge your integrity.
Oh? And can I assume that you will[n]apologize to the authorities as well?
If you think you'll have to apologize later,[n]shouldn't that act as a deterrent for your[n]bad behavior in the first place?
Do remember that some acts cannot be[n]forgiven even with an apology.
...Even so, has it not occurred to you that[n]your behavior until now has been crass[n]and immoral?
I've no intention of arguing with you.
Truly? In that case, I suppose I should[n]apologize. This sort of thing tends to[n]happen more often than I'd like to admit.
Are you defiantly playing the role of victim?[n]I've never met anyone as abominable as[n]you...
Are you really attempting to harm me[n]without touching me? What outrageous[n]behavior...
When a man like you is swept up by emotion[n]and behaves impulsively, he appears base[n]and petty.
If you don't like something, you should[n]simply say so. You're quite the malicious[n]brat, aren't you?
I am not your mother. I refuse to overlook[n]your impertinence.
Excuse me? Learn to read the mood...
I've been projecting a "don't speak to me"[n]aura towards you.
I noticed.
I didn't feel an "aura."
But we may never meet again.
...You noticed, yet you still approached me?[n]Are you a human who values instinct over[n]intellect?
I did see you're quite young for a human.[n]Perhaps you lack the skill to follow up on it.
...I suppose you're the kind of person who[n]claims to do things differently than everyone[n]else...
If you've noticed, then you should take the[n]next step and process what that information[n]means.
Is that so? Strange. Well, I'll try to intensify[n]my vibes so that it's more clear to you, then.
Yes, well, that problem lies with you,[n]the recipient. I'm afraid you must be[n]rather insensitive.
Hearing it put like that offends me[n]somehow. So you were in my presence[n]and felt nothing?
There is nothing worse than meeting[n]someone who cannot feel your aura.
Perhaps, but you should be more[n]considerate. Leave people alone if[n]they wish to be left alone.
But if you cannot feel my aura... Sigh.[n]I suppose it does not matter, in the end...
You're glad to have met me, is that it?[n]Well, I'm flattered...
It pains me to hear you use such a[n]hackneyed turn of phrase, especially[n]when it's not apropos.
How peculiar. I'm fairly certain I've never[n]consented to you firing your gun like that.
Um... You do understand that I neither[n]want to be in this situation nor involved[n]with you...?
Perhaps I am expressing myself too poorly[n]to you, but that was simply unnecessary.
Ah, if you're upset about me insinuating[n]that you are a dolt, then I applaud you[n]for noticing.
I must ask, was there something you desired[n]of me?
I am inclined to turn you down, but if you[n]still wish to speak, I will perhaps consider it.
You have nothing I want.
Do you have time?
Don't turn me down.
You ask nothing of me, yet this is how[n]you treat me? I expected better from[n]you humans...
In that case, I want nothing to do with you,[n]either.
So I was simply a detour on the way to your[n]true objective? Hm... how unfortunate for[n]me.
I did state that I may refuse you, but I[n]never expected you to have no demands[n]whatsoever...
...If you had intended to ask me out—and[n]I'm sure you had—your approach requires[n]improvement.
This is the way you show your interest in[n]me? ...You are utterly hopeless.
Honestly... Do I look like I have time to deal[n]with this nonsense?
Yes, in the sense that I don't know what will[n]happen from here on forth.
Whether or not I do will depend entirely on[n]our conversation henceforth. But at least[n]now I understand how you feel.
As I said, that was only a premise.
Saying such a thing with a gun in your hand[n]makes it a threat, you know.
What a pretentious young man... Your[n]behavior is rather disturbing.
Ah, I apologize if you found my manner of[n]speaking unkind.
Please just tell me what you want already.[n]You are prepared for my refusal, are you[n]not?
You can ask me whatever you like. I am[n]simply stating that I also have a choice.
A crude human like you should be grateful[n]that I even deign to speak to you.
Excuse me, why are you taking so much[n]anger out on me?
What is irritating you so much?
Rotten adults.
Egotistical women.
I'm not irritated.
That's a sentiment I only usually hear from[n]spoiled brats.
May I remind you that you're the one[n]pointing a gun? Who is the rotten one[n]here?
But again, why are you taking your anger[n]out on me?
I will admit, there are adults that even I find[n]impossible to deal with.
Oh, the type that nobody wants to deal[n]with. Don't you hate it when they come[n]to talk to you?
I guess they can't stand not being the focus[n]of attention. Which is why they get left out[n]in the first place.
Is your anger leading you to make poor[n]judgments? You are capable of reason,[n]aren't you?
If I may say so, there is no great difference[n]between women like that and men like you.
Well, I didn't expect you to say that. I don't[n]quite understand your actions then, but...[n]ah well.
So... you're forcing me to endure this for no[n]reason at all!?
You're a bit brutish, but I can sense a bold[n]defiance in your personality.
You're insufferable. I won't tolerate this kind[n]of boorish behavior from you.
Oh, so you aren't taking your anger out[n]upon me... Still, I wish for this to stop.
Don't the humans around you warn you[n]against carrying such dreadful things?
If you aren't irritated, then you're only[n]affirming to me that you're dangerous.
I had not intended to say anything that[n]would elicit this kind of response.
It's frustrating when others bother me when[n]I have things to do.
Won't you just leave me be?
Fine, I will.
I can't just leave you.
Is that reverse psychology?
When you agree to it so quickly, I can't help[n]feeling a bit down...
I can't say that feels genuine if you say it[n]while pointing a gun at me.
Honestly, that's all you had to say from the[n]beginning.
Good. I would be most grateful if you did.
I suppose I should appreciate your[n]consideration.
I think directing your attention to your[n]studies would be far more fruitful for you.
I have neither the need, nor the desire,[n]for your concern.
But that is my request!
To make such an assumption is astounding.[n]You are certainly unique...
Is that how you've interpreted my remarks?[n]Please understand that such was not my[n]intention.
Oh, so you believe that I actually want you[n]to care? I suppose there are people who talk[n]that way.
No. It absolutely isn't.
I thought I asked you to leave me be. What[n]was that for? Are you attention-starved?
Despite my request, you continue to shoot[n]at me. You're not very well-mannered for a[n]human, are you?
If this is a tantrum to get me to care about[n]you, it's having just the opposite effect.
...Would you please just leave me be now?
I know it's odd to say this about myself,[n]but... people who know me will say I never[n]let things go.
You will receive punishment for treating me[n]this way, mark my words.
I'm sorry.
I'm prepared for the worst.
How much do you want?
...I'm shocked that you actually apologized[n]like that.
Oh... I wasn't expecting that...
Do you really mean that...?
...Well, that is reassuring.
So you're more than just talk... Still,[n]your behavior irritates me.
Oh? It seems you're quite the daredevil.
Preparing for the worst... That's exactly what[n]makes you humans so dangerous.
I suppose being prepared would be prudent.
...You are despicable.
...It seems you've got quite the sense of[n]humor.
That isn't what this is about...
You hope to resolve this issue with money[n]alone? Typical human behavior...
Do you intend to strike first before you can[n]be harmed? I guess that makes sense in this[n]case.
Don't be so foolish. If you have any[n]self-awareness, you will cease this[n]behavior at once.
That is what humans call "adding fuel to the[n]fire," is it not? You haven't gone mad, have[n]you?
You're acting quite strangely. You do want[n]to hear what I have to say, do you not?
Allow me to ask you something...
Would you do to anyone else what you're[n]doing to me now?
I sure would.
No, I wouldn't.
This is a special exception.
Anyone at all that enters your field of vision?[n]Is that even a viable trait of human behavior?
Then perhaps the unlucky one in this[n]scenario was me...
You would do this to just anyone?[n]Are you out of your mind?
You're a person of action, I see...
...I suppose that means something about[n]me enticed you. I'll try to look at this more[n]positively.
Then... why did it have to be me? I am[n]finding this dialogue infuriating.
I suppose this means that there is something[n]about me that you especially despise...
Ah, so this is a vagary of fate, is it not?[n]Is this what you humans call "bad luck"...?
Oh, that sounds awfully dubious to me.[n]It sounds like some trite excuse humans[n]always say...
Don't you say that to everyone? And calling[n]something "special" could be construed as[n]"capricious," no?
When you put it that way, well... I suppose[n]I'm all right with it.
The nuance of your words seems favorable,[n]but no, I am still not pleased about all this.
That is your answer, yes? ...Hm, I feel that[n]could be interpreted either way.
...I see. Of course brutes like you couldn't[n]simply adjust their behavior depending on[n]who they speak to.
All I did was ask a simple question. Did that[n]upset you somehow?
If you weren't in the mood for conversation,[n]then you should have told me so from the[n]start.
I've heard that human men have a proclivity[n]to tease the women that interest them.
Is it not possible for this series of events[n]involving you and me to be attributed[n]to that?
Fair enough.
That is incorrect.
What are you talking about?
An affirmative answer, yet such a dry[n]response.
So, then... Is that what is going on here with[n]us?
Hm, that is a very business-like and[n]non-committal response.
The way you said that was unnecessarily[n]cool and composed.
It's clear to me that we fe— Wait, what?[n]You mean to say that I've been mistaken?
I do not appreciate your attempts to[n]deliberately confuse me.
But me thinking that couldn't have been a[n]mere product of my own conceit...
Really? Does that mean you value[n]pragmatism over emotion?
It is cruel of you to make me state this any[n]more clearly than I already have.
Ah, you are the type who needs to define[n]everything clearly.
You're far too obtuse. But, well, never mind[n]that...
Are you really asking me that now?
Are you the type who prefers a thrilling[n]relationship to an emotionally mature[n]one?
I get the feeling that once you start, you'd[n]never quit...
Ah, I assume you don't like clingy partners.
...That awkwardness of yours is somehow[n]refreshing.
No matter the crime, humans treat it more[n]lightly if the perpetrator is a minor, do they[n]not?
Ah, so I suppose you commit such extreme[n]acts because you know you won't be[n]punished harshly...
I'm sorry.
Age doesn't matter.
This isn't extreme.
It's a relief that you're at least smart enough[n]to know when to apologize.
If you believe that you need only apologize[n]to get away with this because you are a[n]minor, you are sorely mistaken.
You can't just rely on adults to protect you[n]no matter what you do.
Thinking that an apology is all you need[n]by this point is precisely what makes you[n]a minor.
You're allowed to say that only if you are[n]self-subsistent.
Arguing every point made against yours is[n]exactly what makes you a brat.
I suppose that age is not a factor in human[n]greed.
Don't you fear punishment? Are humans[n]really so driven by their selfish desires?
I suppose our values are fundamentally[n]different.
Have you ever learned "common sense"?
That... That is not how I perceive it.
Are you the type who pursues what you[n]want with reckless abandon?
...You believe actions speak louder than[n]words, don't you?
We agreed to "talk" about this, didn't we?
I cannot consider being together with a[n]human who is too fast with his hands.
Do you wish to talk? Or do you wish to kill?
I don't mean to doubt you or anything, but[n]would you mind if I ask you a question?
Is there really any benefit for me if I[n]joined with you?
I think there is.
I can't promise that.
It's a matter of feeling.
Then I shall take this opportunity to observe[n]that for myself.
That sort of vague response is very human,[n]in a bad way.
Hearing you say it like that... Well, let's[n]just say that you'd benefit from more[n]confidence.
What you're saying doesn't exactly exude[n]confidence.
I couldn't possibly be with a human who[n]can't promise me something so simple.
Perhaps you just don't understand how[n]to make yourself appealing to others.
I suppose I can appreciate your honesty.
I should have expected your response to be[n]non-committal.
...You must think I'm a foolish woman if[n]you believed that line would distract me[n]from the issue.
Are you saying that, in the end,[n]it's all up to me?
Isn't that just something people say when[n]they're not quite sure of the answer?
It was a simple "yes" or "no" question...
...Let's work on improving our[n]communication skills, shall we?
You are just showing off your strength, are[n]you not?
Evidently, you're the kind of human who[n]can make it on his own.
Ostensibly, there is no benefit for me at all...
If you consider it for a moment, you can't[n]really expect an honest opinion from[n]someone you're threatening at gunpoint.
Don't you think expecting your would-be[n]victim to be receptive to your words is[n]unreasonable?
I do.
I don't.
Don't worry about it.
You seem to be lacking a conscience.[n]Are you certain you are even human?
Oh. So this is the best outcome after you've[n]given all factors their due consideration?
You would do well to abandon your egoistic[n]way of thinking.
It's evident that you struggled while thinking[n]this over.
Who am I kidding... I detest this[n]conversation.
I don't outright reject that way of thinking,[n]but it carries a bias that favors you, yes?
Naturally. If you felt differently, I suppose[n]you wouldn't be doing this.
I do appreciate your candor. It leaves me no[n]freedom to misunderstand you, after all.
Don't fret... about it? That is a unique turn of[n]phrase, evidently for my benefit.
Such an abhorrent, egoistic attitude is true[n]to form for our stereotype of you humans.
I'm talking to you because I can't help[n]fretting about it.
You don't seem the type to hold the[n]emotions of others in high regard.
See, now this is an example of what I mean[n]by unreasonable behavior.
You do understand the principles of[n]conversation, do you not? Were my[n]expectations too high?
Are you saying you will persist in[n]getting what you desire, no matter[n]the consequences?
I suppose the disparity in culture and values[n]between us is just too great.
If I were to die here, my existence up to[n]this point would be rendered meaningless.
But this way of life in this world is all I've[n]ever known.
It's not meaningless.
There are other ways to live.
You had a good run.
Do you mean that? So you can respect me[n]as an equal...?
Hmm? But your words are in direct[n]contradiction to your actions.
Are you saying I should be glad to gain the[n]experience?
It's evident you've only said this to spare my[n]feelings. How mature of you.
I appreciate you getting to the heart of the[n]matter. Perhaps I was overcomplicating[n]things.
You make choosing a way of life sound as[n]frivolous as clothes shopping. Would you[n]not do that?
It bothers me that I cannot imagine a life[n]outside of the one I have now...
It's not your place to say that of someone[n]else's life so easily.
Is that meant to cheer me up?
Are you trying to be nice...?
If that is the case, I will entrust my[n]life to you.
You obviously couldn't care less.
Do you mean to say that if I want to live in[n]the now, I must abandon all I've ever known[n]here?
I can't believe I confessed my worries to you[n]and expected you to take me seriously...
Do you mean to say that I should simply just[n]accept death? How loathsome...
I'm gravely insulted that you've given no[n]consideration for my life and well-being[n]whatsoever.
...For now, I suspect that you've decided to[n]hear me out. Am I not right?
Why have you decided to be more[n]communicative with me?
Your looks.
You seemed useful.
No particular reason.
I must admit, it doesn't feel bad to[n]hear that, but... Okay.
...You mean to tell me that you've come all[n]this way, just to philander with women?
...I don't believe that I'd have much of a[n]future with someone who would tell me[n]that.
I suspected you had some ulterior motive.[n]I suppose I should have expected that from[n]a man like you.
You don't see others as anything but tools,[n]do you?
In that case, I shall assume that you have[n]high expectations for me.
Do you believe so? I do have my strong[n]points and weaknesses...
I am glad you recognize my practical[n]value, but...
I suppose it is wise to trust your[n]instincts at times, but...
You chose to take things this far for no real[n]reason...?
I have never seen such simplicity in a[n]human's behavior...
Do you mean to say that I am not attractive[n]to you at all?
Do you mean to say that I should guess?
Yet another human who can't handle basic[n]communication...
Please, I must ask you to behave with a little[n]more common sense.
Is it really that troublesome to at least[n]confirm or deny my assertions?
We were trying to kill each other just a short[n]while ago. It's surprising if you think about it.
I wonder if us speaking together like[n]this now means that we are somehow[n]connected...
It could be.
No way.
It's fate.
Hm, I thought so. I'm glad to see that[n]humans can feel the same way.
I hope this connection can blossom[n]henceforth.
"Could be"? Aren't you being a bit curt?
"Could be"? The ambiguity of your words[n]troubles me.
Well, that was extremely blunt. You may be[n]correct, but...
It's rather annoying if I'm the only one who[n]is excited over the implications of all this...
In that case, I should approach this with the[n]same sort of practicality.
So rather than depend on fate, we must take[n]action in the relationship ourselves...
Fate? That's the word you choose in this[n]situation?
Oh, you humans and your clichés...[n]Not that I necessarily disapprove.
Fate? Does that mean you also believe in[n]things such as reincarnation and karma?
Are you trying to look smarter by using[n]difficult words?
I see. Perhaps we are connected, but you're[n]willing to see this feud to the bitter end...
Humans may be foolish at times, but this[n]sort of behavior is more befitting of a beast.
I suppose it was rather silly to think this[n]was all brought about by some connection[n]between us...
So... there is no connection between us?
All this would never have happened if you[n]had not come here.
I suppose this "real world" where you come[n]from must be fairly boring.
You're right.
It keeps me busy.
It's better than here.
In that case, you'd better find some new way[n]to occupy yourself when you return to your[n]world.
Oh? Then how do you deal with all the[n]boredom?
You sound detached. I don't know if being[n]with you would be very entertaining...
Going with you to such a mundane place[n]doesn't sound very appealing...
If you're so busy, then why are you wasting[n]time here?
Ah, I've heard there are humans out there[n]who pride themselves in being "busy." Is[n]that true?
Being so busy has clearly turned you into a[n]nervous wreck... Thus, you took it out on me.
In that case, I suppose we wouldn't be able[n]to spend very much time together there.
If that is true, then would it not be better for[n]you to return home?
Well, I've only known this place, so I suppose[n]I'll have to take you at your word.
Even so, this place is my home.
...Ah, you said it. I suspected as much.
On second thought, with one of those in[n]your possession, how could you possibly[n]be bored?
Have I upset you? Well, I feel the same way.
...Do you not have any communication skills[n]at all, human?
So that is the manner in which you wish to do[n]things? In that case, I shall follow suit.
Perhaps you may find our kind rather[n]annoying, but...
You do understand that we are here[n]because of people like you, right?
I never thought of that.
I understand.
What do you mean?
I suspected as much. You're really hopeless,[n]human.
I see, you came here BECAUSE you're[n]ignorant. That makes sense.
Well then, I strongly suggest that you give it[n]more thought.
So you're the sort to act on impulse alone,[n]then? How surprising...
...Hm. You have little self-control over your[n]desires, don't you?
Have you no concern about the trouble you[n]cause others?
At the very least, you're possessed of a[n]willful drive and stubborn resolve.
Are you trying to steal or kill...? What in the[n]world are you, anyway?
You're not losing your temper, are you?[n]More importantly, you should answer[n]my question.
You're quite the handful. What am I[n]supposed to do with you?
I've been trying to speak to you normally,[n]but you are far too slow on the uptake.
Shall I try to explain it once more? No, never[n]mind, it wouldn't be worth all the effort.
Are you surprised? You had no idea until[n]now?
You probably don't even realize that your[n]actions prove my point...
Ah, it's fine. I understand that you don't[n]comprehend what I'm saying.
You started this conversation with me, and[n]now you deem it not worth your time?
Speaking of which, I have heard that young[n]people today have poor communication[n]skills.
You, however, are talking to me right here.[n]Are you the exception to this rule?
I'm not special.
That's right.
I have ulterior motives.
My, aren't you humble for a human?
Oh, I'm aware that's something humans[n]say to appear humble, an exercise in false[n]modesty.
Being overly modest will lead to people[n]taking advantage of you for the rest of[n]your life, you know.
I intended to compliment you, but you're[n]saying I was mistaken about you being[n]exceptional?
Bragging like that is nothing more than[n]obnoxious.
Do you always insist on letting people talk[n]about you instead of talking about yourself?
Upon consideration, I wouldn't be a very[n]good fit with such a special human as[n]yourself.
I have no doubt that you are exceptional in[n]more ways than one.
Does that mean you would prefer some nice[n]"thing" over me?
I'm not accustomed to people being so[n]direct, but I am impressed by your honesty.
Well, unfortunately, I have nothing on hand.[n]Oh dear, whatever shall we do?
Ah, this must be the excessive greed[n]of the introvert...
Perhaps I was the only one who thought we[n]could have a conversation...
That response was special in a way that was[n]uniquely you.
...It appears we have both found this[n]conversation tedious.
Ah, evidently, I've been gravely mistaken.[n]My apologies.
You have teammates who would mourn you[n]if something were to happen, do you not?
I also have loved ones who would miss me.[n]You do catch my meaning, yes?
I do now.
That doesn't matter.
I'm always alone.
Hm. It does appear that you are reflecting[n]on your actions...
I see. Of course it wouldn't occur to a[n]common thief beforehand.
It's about time you noticed.
Yes, and things are this way now because[n]you are only capable of thinking solely of[n]yourself.
You humans are capable of saying such[n]cold-hearted things.
I suppose you're right. Even I'm unsure of[n]what I'm saying...
...You're right. My apologies, it was rude of[n]me to bring it up.
Oh? Perhaps we disagree, but I still admire[n]your conviction.
Then how do you explain these other[n]humans surrounding us?
I'm sorry, but that is just too tragic.
I wonder if everyone who talks to you gets[n]as depressed as I do.
Well, the underlying cause of that is most[n]likely your personality. Have you ever[n]considered that?
You mean to say that you really understand[n]me?
If you don't catch my meaning, you could[n]just ask me to explain.
Are you attacking me because what I'm[n]saying frustrates and confuses you? You[n]are a lost cause, human.
Oh, forget it. You are far too brutish to get[n]along with.
Truth be told, I cannot dismiss the idea of[n]being with you entirely...
But is it fair to my kind if only I find such[n]happiness, leaving them all behind?
I think so.
They can all come.
Your kind?
It's quite a relief to hear that from you.
Please don't give me such an ambiguous[n]answer after you've already made me[n]reconsider...
I thought so. I mean, you're right, but...
Still, this is quite sudden... I cannot make up[n]my mind at the moment. But then again...
Is the happiness of everyone involved[n]your ideal?
I see... You are thinking in terms of our[n]happiness, not just my own.
But... you're not choosing me alone in that[n]scenario, are you?
It's as though you're shepherding a herd of[n]animals, and I'm simply one of the flock... I[n]dislike that sort of thinking.
